title: Gratin Pear Crumble
description: A delicious dessert combining the sweetness of pears with a crunchy topping, perfect for a cozy evening.

ingredients.name: Pears
ingredients.notes: Any variety, but firmer pears work best

instructions: Peel, core, and slice the pears. In a large bowl, combine the pears and sugar. Let it sit for 15 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and softened butter until crumbly. Add the heavy cream and mix until it forms a smooth batter.
Transfer the pear mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish and top with the batter.
Spread the gratin topping evenly over the batter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.
